name: Global New Material International Holdings Limited
summary: Global New Material International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, produces and sells pearlescent pigment, functional mica filler, and related products in the People's Republic of China, Europe, the rest of Asia, North America, and internationally. The company offers natural mica, synthetic mica industrial grade, highlight series, high purity series, chameleon series, velvet series, jade series, 3D magnetic conductive series, China red series, diamond series, weather resistant series, powder coating series, and cosmetic grade pearlescent pigments; and cosmetic active ingredients, industrial and automotive coatings, new energy materials, and sustainable, green materials.
